ondc.title: ONDC
ondc.description: Offer your products on the Open Network for Digital Commerce. You choose which listings to add, and every order comes to you to accept or reject.
ondc.notLive: ONDC is not live yet. You can connect and choose listings now; nothing is shown to buyers on the network until we go live.
ondc.listingsReady: {count, plural, one {# listing ready for the network.} other {# listings ready for the network.}}
ondc.noListingsDescription: Create and publish a listing first, then add it to ONDC here.

reason.seller_unverified: Complete verification to sell on ONDC
reason.no_price: Add a price to sell on ONDC

ondc.termsText: I have read and accept the ONDC seller terms: my opted-in listings may be shown to ONDC buyer apps, and orders arrive in my ONDC inbox for me to accept or reject.
ondc.acceptTerms: Please accept the ONDC seller terms to connect.

orders.title: ONDC orders
orders.description: Orders placed by buyers on the ONDC network. Accept or reject each one; the buyer's app is told straight away.
orders.emptyDescription: Orders from the network appear here.
